# extend installation script with xcode-select

Have the installer trigger `xcode-select --install` so that the Command Line Tools — `git`, compilers, headers that Homebrew needs — are present on a factory-fresh Mac before anything else runs.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/258#issuecomment-5711693598
Code vs intent: `install-clt` guards with `command -v xcode-select`, which is true on every Mac (the launcher ships with the OS), so `xcode-select --install` is never reached. The real check is `xcode-select -p` (exit status) or the presence of `/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools`. The step therefore never installs the tools it exists for.
-->
